Event

Guild Trade Festival

In this season, adventurers are collecting and selling materials everywhere. Come on! Let's enjoy the Trade Festival!

Activity TypeTradeFesPhases7Duration7 or 8 days

Across all phases

GameplayEvent Rules7 sections
Basic Rules

◆ Event Period: Open for All Day!

◆ During the Trade Festival, Transcenders can go to different areas with other Transcenders to trade local specialties and distribute them to other places. During the event, if you quit a guild, your personal points remain unchanged. The original guild’s guild points will be reduced by your personal points. If you join a new guild, your personal points will not contribute to the new guild’s guild points.

Trade

◆ It'll cost 1 Trade Permit every time you go to other areas.

◆ Trade Permits regenerate over time: 1 Permit every 60 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit. In addition, Transcenders can spend Crystals to purchase Trade Permits during the event.

◆ After the event ends, Trade Permits will be retained and can be used in future Trade Festivals.

Trade and Replenishment

◆ In each area, Transcenders can spend Festival Exclusive Trade Tickets to buy various materials and sell them at a high price to other areas to earn Trade Points.

◆ The price of each material may vary in different areas, and it changes every time the market inventory is refreshed.

◆ Each area will have its local specialties, and usually, the price of specialties is much lower than its standard price, worth purchasing for Transcenders.

◆ The inventory of goods in each area is limited, and once sold out, you will need to wait for the next replenishment.

◆ Each replenishment will refresh the prices and inventory of goods in various areas on a guild basis, allowing Transcenders to cooperate with others, and share intelligence from various areas to maximize profits.

Caravan Level

◆ Every time Transcenders consume a Trade Permit, they will improve their Caravan EXP, thereby increasing the caravan level.

◆ To reward Transcenders' active performance during the Trade Festival, they will receive additional rewards when Caravan Level is improved.

◆ Expand Space: The guild president will provide you with stronger vehicles, increasing the cargo space of your caravan.

◆ Extra Points: You will receive additional points every time you trade.

Tickets and Points

◆ Trade Tickets: Exclusive tickets used during the Trade Festival to purchase goods. They can be obtained by selling goods.

◆ Trade Points: The total value of trade vouchers and current cost of owned goods. It is the only proof for ranking during the Grand Trade Fair.

Achievement Rewards

◆ Consume Trade Permits of a certain amount to claim corresponding rewards.

◆ Super Achievement Progress resets when each event ends.

Rankings

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

Points

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

Points

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

Points

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

Points

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

Points

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

Points

◆ The rankings in Trade Festival are divided into Personal Ranking and Guild Ranking.

◆ Personal Ranking: The Personal Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by Transcenders personally.

◆ Guild Ranking: The Guild Ranking is based on the Trade Points accumulated by all the members in the guild.

◆ As the event opens for multiple times, the rewards will be more and more abundant. While the exchange shop will be open for Transcenders to redeem rare items.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.
